notes.title: Demo 1.1.0 – Major Gameplay Changes
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]We’ve just released a [b]massive update[/b] to the demo. [/p][p]The [b]Omnicore[/b] system has been [b]completely redesigned[/b], combat and characters rebalanced, sound design improved, turrets updated, UI improved, and we’ve even added some fun new interactions (yes, the seagulls are real). And also... some quests and lore![/p][p]Let’s dive into the details:[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🧠 Omnicore – Simplified and More Fun[/h2][p][i]The Omnicore was previously complex and not as rewarding as we wanted. We've streamlined its role to make it much more enjoyable to use.[/i][/p][h3]What's changed:[/h3][list][*][p]The Omnicore can no longer be placed on the ground. It must now be either [b]held by a player[/b] or [b]attached to a Guardian (turret)[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]100% energy empowered active[/b] has been removed.[/p][/*][*][p]The Omnicore no longer has health.
